evidence.decision: Establishes parent blocking and focus benefit before selecting a presentation; identifies nonmodal alternatives and separates fullscreen appearance from modality.
evidence.artifact: Produces an entry/parent availability/task/exit/data/return contract, or source-located review findings; requires changed behavior for adaptation.
evidence.transformation: Archive collection keeps cover selection within one coherent sheet, distinguishes Back from Cancel/Done and shares dirty-draft protection across gestures and buttons.
evidence.verification: Tests clean/dirty exits, Back preservation, completion, obsolete-view reopening and stacked presentations, with explicit failure conditions.
evidence.applicability: Cross-checked sheets and popovers source: iOS/iPadOS nonmodal sheets, parent-scoped Mac modality, unsupported popover platforms and Shared Space distinctions are qualified.
evidence.handoffs: Selected presentation topics must be loaded before detailed prescriptions; persistence and accessibility handoffs retain the transition contract.
evidence.distinctiveness: Blocking benefit, data-policy parity across every exit and presentation competition are specific operational decisions rather than summary headings.
